values.en: A Chosen Local Unit Normal Field
values.zh-CN: 选定的局部单位法向场

values.en: Let $\Omega\subseteq\mathbb R^2$ be Euclidean open and $X:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$ be smooth and regular on $\Omega$. At $q\in\Omega$, put $U=X_u(q)$ and $V=X_v(q)$; these form a basis of $T_qX$. Fix a smooth map $\boldsymbol N:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$ on $\Omega$ such that, for every $r\in\Omega$, $\|\boldsymbol N(r)\|=1$ and $\boldsymbol N(r)\perp X_u(r),X_v(r)$. Only restrictions to $\Omega$ matter. The normal $\boldsymbol N_X(r)=(X_u(r)\times X_v(r))/\|X_u(r)\times X_v(r)\|$ from the existing unit-normal definition is a permitted choice; the opposite is also permitted. Outside $\Omega$ values may be assigned arbitrarily.
values.zh-CN: 设 $\Omega\subseteq\mathbb R^2$ 为欧氏开集，$X:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$ 在 $\Omega$ 上光滑且正则。取 $q\in\Omega$，记 $U=X_u(q)$、$V=X_v(q)$，它们构成 $T_qX$ 的一组基。固定在 $\Omega$ 上光滑的映射 $\boldsymbol N:\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R^3$，对每个 $r\in\Omega$ 满足 $\|\boldsymbol N(r)\|=1$ 且 $\boldsymbol N(r)\perp X_u(r),X_v(r)$。只使用在 $\Omega$ 上的限制。已有单位法向定义给出的 $\boldsymbol N_X(r)=(X_u(r)\times X_v(r))/\|X_u(r)\times X_v(r)\|$ 是可选法向，其反向也允许；$\Omega$ 外任意赋值。
